goal: Turn Phase154-160 evidence into a deterministic cross-layer diagnostic engine that asks the minimum next safe question instead of guessing a root cause.
decision_policy: Unknown/not-tested is an evidence gap, not failure evidence.
Earliest unresolved dependency is checked before downstream speculation.
When multiple questions are possible, prefer the one that separates more active candidates, then lower-risk/lower-effort checks.
A later-layer success may exclude some earlier failures but never reveals hidden implementation details.
No unobserved root cause is promoted to a confirmed diagnosis.
notable_behaviors: eSIM profile install -> next ask profile enablement.
Profile enabled but carrier line switch failed -> localize carrier activation stage.
In service but data registration absent -> localize registration failure before APN.
Registered but no data and APN unknown -> ask APN/DNN next.
Data works but voice fails and IMS is unknown -> ask IMS policy before calling it a directional voice fault.
5G SA confirmed with unknown voice bearer -> ask VoNR bearer; never infer VoNR.
5G+/NR Advanced display without physical channels -> ask PhysicalChannelConfig; never infer NR CA.
next_phase: Phase162 real-device capture/test format: produce repeatable device × carrier × SIM/eSIM × software-snapshot logs that can feed Phase161 automatically.
